_comment: mobileSnapshot is what apps/mobile computed at 12dc7ab0f, before this logic moved to core. Do not regenerate it from core.
Captured by rendering HEAD TaskEditScheduleField and TaskEditOrganizationField with useTaskEditDates and useTaskEditDerivedState
(English strings, TZ and clock pinned, Platform android), folding every setDraftField through HEAD setTaskDraftField (no cascades).
custom: task-edit-modal openCustomRecurrence and applyCustomRecurrence copied verbatim from HEAD: [anchor|rrule] -> [open state, applied rules].
display[task|format|field]: date fields [button text, compact due row, time button label, Date only shown, chips [label, selected],
issue text, repeat reminder label, skip switch]; recurrence {rules, interval, weekdays, monthly, ends, count, untilLabel, strategy}.
ops[task|settings|field|op]: [draft after the op as [start, due, review, offset, rule, strategy, rrule, repeat, skip, estimate, spent],
then the field display after it: dates [text, time label, Date only, issue, repeat, skip]; recurrence as in display].
estimates[task|step]: [draft estimate or time spent, input text]. timeSpentFlags[settings]: the Time Spent field is shown.
Weekday buttons were rendered with labels day:<code> so the capture could press them; labels are not part of the snapshot.
dstSnapshot: the same capture at 12dc7ab0f with the clock on DST days in New York: ops[now|task|settings|field|op] as in ops.
A time pick hands RN the picked hour and minute on the picker date (the field, else now); 02:30 on 2027-03-14 does not exist.
